title: Diwan
desc: A cook falls in love with a wealthy man's daughter. However, after receiving her father's disparaging remarks, he embraces the challenge to amass a fortune within a year.

title: Varusham 16
desc: Kannan, a teenager, falls in love with his uncle's daughter, Radhika, but things turn upside down when her grandmother disapproves of their relationship.

title: Virumbugiren
desc: When Shivan is forced to take up his father's job, he falls in love with Thavamani while posted in a village. However, he faces several problems as her father and the villagers are against their love.

title: Idhaya Thamarai
desc: Vijay, a short-tempered man, falls in love with Manju. However, he is imprisoned after an incident and upon his release, he learns about Manju's marriage.

title: Chinna Thambi
desc: After an astrologer predicts that their sister will marry a man of her own choosing, three protective brothers go to dire lengths to prevent the prophecy from being fulfilled.
